interpretation: Checkpoint contamination is not the limiting issue. Published weights have declared non-MASLD corpora and no upstream weight is admitted locally. The disqualifying fact is architectural: multiDGD learns one parameter vector per cell and infers every unseen cell by optimizing a new vector against its observed RNA partial likelihood. Its ATAC branch then returns a normalized negative-binomial mean profile without target ATAC, but that is not a frozen raw-RNA transform. The exact release also mutates and saves test state, can fit a new correction component, and contains a static new-data entrypoint naming defect. GSE289173 therefore remains completely unexposed and cannot evaluate this model under the sealed contract.
remaining_blockers: Remove multiDGD from active common-lane, sealed, champion, and direct RNA-to-ATAC scheduling. Do not count a decoder-only query optimization as a frozen embedding or forward pass.

If scientific interest justifies it, approve a separate nonpromotable TaskSpec before any run. Label the method outcome-blind per-query optimization and prohibit comparison as a frozen representation model.

Document a minimal project patch for predict_new calling the absent _init_test_set method, suppress automatic save of query state, and make every query representation ephemeral. Static inspection found these defects; no execution test was performed.
Use only outer-training GSE296875 same-nucleus pairs after exact ordered ID validation. Reject GSE244832 different aliquots as training pairs regardless of matched donor or cell-state labels.

Freeze genes, peaks, raw-count representation, decoder, mixture, query initialization, epochs, optimizer, convergence rule, correction exclusion, profile definition, folds, and seeds before a diagnostic evaluation.

Prove held ATAC, labels, target depth, early stopping, calibration, and other query rows cannot affect a query latent vector. Keep structural missingness explicit and never create an observed zero ATAC vector.

Never load the published .pt files. If a local diagnostic is approved, reconstruct the audited architecture and restore project-controlled tensor state while excluding all query-specific representations from reusable checkpoints.
Resolve the legacy Python, Torch, dense-memory, state-dict, deterministic initialization, and numeric-tolerance behavior on L40S before any approved smoke job.
Keep GSE289173 features, labels, and outcomes outside every multiDGD adapter, patch, diagnostic, head, and calibration experiment.
